description: React component for displaying detailed information about a target role, including skills, responsibilities, compatibility score, and related reports.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of trimmed strings, filtering out falsy values.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Converts an array of strings into bulleted sentences, ensuring proper punctuation.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Clamps a number to the range 0-100, rounding to the nearest integer.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Extracts and deduplicates persona skills from various nested schema fields.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Normalizes a skill string to lowercase trimmed form.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds intersection of persona skills with required skills, preserving order and deduplicating.
